## What this does


## Checklist
- [ ] `bun run lint` is clean
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` is clean
- [ ] `bun run test` passes
- [ ] `bun run check` is clean (guardrails: boundaries, error codes, test timeouts, changelog links)
- [ ] For changes under `web/`: `bun run --cwd web test` passes and `bun run --cwd web build` is clean
- [ ] **Required:** I have read and agree to the contribution terms in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/LunarWerxs/RepoYeti/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) - I grant LunarWerx LLC (LunarWerx Studios) a perpetual, irrevocable right to use, modify and **relicense** my contribution, including commercially (including assignment of copyright where the law allows it).
